points.text: The linked article reports that Take-Two’s DMCA notice targets the Leonida repository and its 3,007 forks, shutting down the project on GitHub.
The tracker records that darkworldhm joined the board, claiming the stage "Runnable".
The tracker records that keylime joined the board, claiming the stage "Main menu".
The linked article reports that GTA VI’s shaders start loading on omonkey’s build, streamed live on Rumble, with a player walking slowly around the opening prison scene at about 5 frames per second.

sentences.text: The linked article reports that ZETTROX's GitHub repository and account vanished, with the repo and account answering 404 by 17:26 UTC on Wednesday.
The linked article says that omonkey's private build was taken down the same day, and that no DMCA notice has been published.
Hardware Busters reports that Project Leonida goes dark as fake builds spread malware.
MakeUseOf claims that fake GTA 6 installers steal accounts for a nonexistent port.
Yahoo Tech reports that GTA 6 raises privacy concerns over Rockstar and Take-Two data.
The linked article says private builds now play through Lucia's prologue into Jason's first mission, though rendering is poor.
Notebookcheck reports that a GTA 6 game dump runs on PS5 jailbreak, boosting piracy and PC emulation.
